stops.detail: The Stubai Valley or Stubaital (German pronunciation: [ˈʃtuːbaɪ̯ˌtaːl] ) is an alpine valley in Tyrol, Austria. It is the central valley of the Stubai Alps. The river Ruetz flows through the valley.
